name: Kenji Tanaka
psychographics: Prefers stability and predictability; wary of flashy new tech that complicates daily routines
current_solutions: Supermarket weekly shop at Aeon; Local butcher for meat; Pays bills at the konbini (convenience store); Uses basic feature phone for calls only
frustration: Forced to use the restaurant's POS system to transfer a takeout order at 2:15 PM on a Thursday; the interface was in English only, the screen froze twice, and he had to abandon the order and pay cash instead, losing the loyalty points
decision_style: Sticks to familiar brands; will try a new product only if a colleague recommends it outright, otherwise ignores marketing entirely
voice: Formal and reserved; speaks in complete, polite sentences; rarely uses slang, preferring standard Japanese business keigo when explaining problems
